description: This file contains unit tests for the ThemeOverlayCombiner class in the com.anysoftkeyboard.overlay package. It tests overlay data application, drawable filtering, and icon coloring behaviors within the theme overlay system.

classes.name: ThemeOverlayCombinerTest
classes.description: A test class for ThemeOverlayCombiner, containing multiple test cases to verify its behavior.

methods.name: overlay
methods.description: Helper method to create OverlayData instances with specified colors.

methods.name: testProvidesColorDrawableIfThemeDidNotProvideDrawables
methods.description: Tests that default color drawables are provided when theme does not supply drawables.

methods.name: testClearFilterOnSetNewDrawable
methods.description: Verifies that color filters are cleared when setting a new drawable.

methods.name: testHappyPath
methods.description: Tests the typical usage flow of setting overlay data and retrieving theme resources.

methods.name: testApplyOnIcon
methods.description: Checks that overlay effects are correctly applied and cleared on icons.

methods.name: extractColorFromFilter
methods.description: Utility method to extract color information from a drawable's color filter.
